# platform-orchestrator_module_version_pin (Data Source)

Reads one exact Orchestrator Environment Module Version Pin and its complete append-only history.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Module Version Pin UUID.

### Read-Only

- `activation_event_id` (String) Latest event that established the current approval boundary. Notes never change it.
- `created_by` (String)
- `creation_reason` (String)
- `environment_uuid` (String)
- `events_json` (String) Complete ordered Pin lifecycle and note history as JSON.
- `module_uuid` (String)
- `override_actor` (String)
- `override_deployment_id` (String)
- `override_operation_id` (String)
- `override_reason` (String)
- `project_uuid` (String)
- `resource_version` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `version_uuid` (String)
